project: Commercial OCR First + VLM/LLM Semantic Assembler
description: Keep development on main while migrating the scanned PDF parsing path to commercial OCR first, then OCR normalization, semantic assembly, quality gating, M5A answer-book alignment, M5B similarity detection, admin review, and publish. Preserve the existing local parser as a fallback and A/B baseline until the commercial OCR path proves stable on real papers, especially shared-material question ranges such as 17-20.

userStories.title: Merge validation branch into main safely
userStories.description: As the repository maintainer, I need the current validation branch merged into main without force push, without losing user code, and without carrying runtime/debug artifacts into version control.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the merge source branch from git history instead of guessing
Create a checkpoint commit on the validation branch when uncommitted source/docs/test changes exist
Merge the validation branch into main with --no-ff
Remove tracked runtime/debug artifacts from version control while keeping local files intact
Run the required verification commands and record any failures truthfully
Push origin/main without force push
userStories.notes: Merged validation branch into main with d411a90, removed tracked debug/runtime artifacts with 2fbf506, and kept origin/main updated. Evidence: docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M0-baseline.md and COCR-M1-merge-main-and-provider-baseline.md.

userStories.title: Establish commercial OCR provider baseline
userStories.description: As a parser engineer, I need a provider abstraction that supports mock, Baidu paper_cut_edu, Tencent question split stub, and local parser fallback so the OCR-first path can evolve without rewriting the whole parser.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a provider interface that returns ProviderOCRResult
Support provider ids mock_commercial_ocr, baidu_paper_cut_edu, tencent_question_split, and local_parser
Load all keys and endpoints from environment variables only
Record provider latency, provider status, provider error, raw response ref, and fallback_used
Preserve the local parser path as the final fallback
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Provider abstraction now supports mock_commercial_ocr, mock_tencent_question_split, mock_tencent_question_split_layout, baidu_paper_cut_edu, tencent_question_split, tencent_question_split_layout, and local_parser fallback. Evidence: pdf-service/commercial_ocr/, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M1-merge-main-and-provider-baseline.md, COCR-M8-tencent-ocr-adapter.md.

userStories.title: Implement mock provider and deterministic tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a mock commercial OCR provider so fallback logic and parser integration can be tested without calling a real API.
acceptanceCriteria: Mock provider returns deterministic normalized OCR blocks from fixture or extracted page text
Tests cover provider selection and fallback order
Tests confirm mock provider does not call a real HTTP API
Tests confirm missing real-provider keys skip that provider cleanly
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Deterministic fixtures and mock providers landed with no-network tests, provider failure controls, and fixture secret scans. Evidence: pdf-service/tests/fixtures/commercial_ocr/, tests/test_commercial_ocr_pipeline.py, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M2-mock-provider.md.

userStories.title: Normalize commercial OCR output into parser inputs
userStories.description: As a parser engineer, I need normalized OCR blocks and page payloads so the existing parser kernel can consume commercial OCR output before the semantic assembler is ready.
acceptanceCriteria: Create NormalizedOCRBlock with the required block_type taxonomy
Convert provider page results into PageContent blocks and visual regions
Store commercial OCR execution summary in parse stats
Do not break the existing parser kernel for local_parser fallback
Tests pass
userStories.notes: OCR blocks now normalize across Baidu, Tencent QuestionSplitOCR, Tencent QuestionSplitLayoutOCR, and local parser pages with bbox validation and raw redaction. Evidence: pdf-service/commercial_ocr/normalizer.py, tests/test_commercial_ocr_normalizer.py, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M3-ocr-normalizer.md.

userStories.title: Design shared-material data model for 17-20 style questions
userStories.description: As a semantic assembler maintainer, I need MaterialGroup and NormalizedQuestion contracts that can represent one shared material block linked to multiple independent questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add MaterialGroup with question_range, shared_stem, shared_assets, source_page_span, source_blocks, grouping_evidence, grouping_confidence, needs_human_review, and warnings
Add NormalizedQuestion with material_id, shared_stem_ref, local_stem, full_stem, question_range, grouping_evidence, grouping_confidence, and validation warnings
Document how 17-20 shared material should be represented without duplicating shared_stem into every local_stem
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MaterialGroup, NormalizedQuestion, and SemanticAssemblyResult now represent 17-20 shared-material ranges without duplicating shared stem into local stem. Evidence: pdf-service/commercial_ocr/types.py, semantic_assembler.py, tests/test_commercial_ocr_semantic_assembler.py, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M4-semantic-assembler.md.

userStories.title: Add semantic assembler baseline
userStories.description: As a downstream reviewer, I need the system to combine OCR blocks and visual understanding summaries into material groups and question groups instead of treating every extracted question as isolated text.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a semantic assembler entry point that reads OCR blocks plus visual summaries
Emit grouping_evidence, grouping_confidence, and grouping_warnings
Set needs_human_review when grouping is uncertain
Do not merge unrelated questions based on hardcoded page numbers or bank ids
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Semantic assembler baseline now emits material groups, question groups, grouping evidence/confidence, and human-review flags from normalized OCR blocks. Evidence: pdf-service/commercial_ocr/semantic_assembler.py, tests/test_commercial_ocr_semantic_assembler.py, eval output under pdf-service/debug/commercial-ocr-eval/20260504-233354/evaluation.json.

userStories.title: Add visual understanding assist layer
userStories.description: As a parser maintainer, I need VLM-based page understanding to verify chart titles, legends, table headers, and cross-page material ownership without replacing OCR itself.
acceptanceCriteria: Pass original page screenshot plus bbox overlay into the visual understanding step
Detect missing chart title, legend, table header, axis labels, or notes
Flag uncertain cross-page material ownership for human review
Do not use VLM as the primary OCR source
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Selected-case visual understanding is now wired into the commercial OCR execution path as a mock assist layer. It triggers for shared-material / chart / low-confidence / incomplete cases, emits grouping and asset warnings, and reaches backend review DTOs. Evidence: pdf-service/commercial_ocr/visual_understanding.py, tests/test_commercial_ocr_visual_understanding.py, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M5-visual-understanding-backend.md.

userStories.title: Introduce parse quality gate
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I need a quality gate that rejects incomplete parses even when question_count looks correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ParseQualityGateResult with extraction_complete, ocr_complete, visual_assets_preserved, semantic_consistent, reasoning_verified, review_ready, extracted_but_incomplete, needs_human_review, blocking_reasons, warnings, and per_question_status
Mark answer=null as incomplete
Mark analysis=unknown as incomplete
Mark missing bbox or missing question_image_ref as needs_human_review
Mark uncertain material groups or provider conflicts as needs_human_review
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Parse quality gate now evaluates extraction completeness, OCR completeness, visual asset preservation, semantic consistency, extracted-but-incomplete state, and review readiness. Evidence: pdf-service/commercial_ocr/quality_gate.py, tests/test_commercial_ocr_quality_gate.py, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M7-quality-gate.md.

userStories.title: Integrate real Baidu paper_cut_edu trace and fallback evidence
userStories.description: As an operations engineer, I need the real Baidu adapter to archive redacted traces locally and expose provider errors so fallback behavior is explainable in review and reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Use Baidu OAuth access_token flow or BAIDU_ACCESS_TOKEN override
Archive local provider traces outside git-tracked paths
Expose error_code and error_msg when Baidu returns an error
Preserve the primary provider error when fallback succeeds
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Baidu real smoke and fallback evidence remain tracked from M1, and Tencent adapter now adds env-driven endpoint/version/smoke gating plus trace archiving. Evidence: docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M1-merge-main-and-provider-baseline.md and COCR-M8-tencent-ocr-adapter.md.

userStories.title: Prepare admin review and publish contracts for OCR-first data
userStories.description: As an admin reviewer, I need OCR-first parse metadata and review flags to reach the review and publish surfaces without breaking existing M5A and M5B workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Preserve existing M5A and M5B logic
Expose provider trace refs and grouping warnings for review use
Prevent auto-publish when quality gate says extracted_but_incomplete or needs_human_review
Document follow-up review UI requirements for shared-material questions
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend review and preview-publish DTOs now expose provider trace refs, material groups, quality gate, and visual understanding; admin review blocks non-review-ready candidates from draft/publish and h5 preview preserves shared materials after publish-preview. Existing M5A/M5B flows remain intact. Evidence: backend/src/modules/pdf/pdf.service.ts, admin-web/src/views/pdf/PaperReviewView.vue, e2e/commercial-ocr-admin.spec.ts, e2e/commercial-ocr-h5.spec.ts, docs/commercial-ocr-phase-reports/COCR-M8b-backend-provider-wiring.md, COCR-M9-admin-review-ui-publish-gate.md, COCR-M10-full-chain-playwright-e2e.md.

userStories.title: Keep git hygiene enforced for OCR-first iteration
userStories.description: As a repository maintainer, I need runtime files, uploads, provider traces, and local secrets kept out of git while source, tests, docs, prd.json, progress.txt, and minimal fixtures remain trackable.
acceptanceCriteria: Update .gitignore with the required runtime/debug patterns
Do not track .env, uploads, provider trace output, or large raw API response dumps
Keep source, tests, docs, prd.json, progress.txt, and .env.example trackable
Do not force push or rewrite history
git status is understandable after the changes
userStories.notes: Git hygiene continues to ignore secrets, uploads, provider traces, eval output, local PDFs, and the original Baidu sample JS while keeping source/tests/docs/fixtures trackable. Evidence: .gitignore, COCR-M0/COCR-M1 reports, and this round's clean fixture set.

acceptanceCriteria: Preserve OCR/provider bbox, answer candidate, analysis candidate, layout-only, and raw refs through normalization and semantic assembly
Represent 17-20 shared material with table/chart assets and keep local stems free of shared-stem duplication
Add data-analysis visual context, understanding result, and quality gate payloads
Expose data-analysis payloads through backend question_quality.commercial_ocr without a DB migration
Route /banks into /workbench and redirect old /banks/:id/questions to workbench
Cover workbench and H5 shared-material behavior with Playwright and record evidence truthfully
